card.name: Right before the word man or men
card.fires_on: Responds to the spot just before a word ending in -man or -men is completed, such as numbers before '-man', 'white' before 'man', or the middle of words like henchmen, airmen, alderman.

modes.label: Partway through -man compounds
modes.description: Inside a longer word that finishes with man or men, such as henchmen, airmen, alderman, selectman.

modes.label: Modifier before man
modes.description: An adjective or number that is followed by man, as in white man or 200-man.
modes.example: have always remained the<< white>> man's friend.

card.writes: It pushes the model to output man or men as the next piece.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to finish a word like airmen, henchmen or 'white man'.
